name: Sunbaked Courtyard
description: Ochre plaster, amber brass, and long golden shadows. The closest evolution of the current courtyard.

name: Terracotta Terrace
description: Clay red, apricot light, and heat haze over rooftops. The warmest, most architectural direction.

name: Saffron Market
description: Burnt-orange textiles, spice gold, and sunlight through awnings. A richer, more tactile market courtyard.
